records.title: StreamReady: Learning What to Answer and When in Long Streaming Videos
records.reason: StreamReady adds readiness-aware answering for long streaming video. This may affect when an agent spends compute, but its evaluation is answer timing/correctness rather than inference cost or serving throughput.

records.title: VideoAuto-R1: Video Auto Reasoning via Thinking Once, Answering Twice
records.reason: VideoAuto-R1 studies video reasoning task formulation and answer quality; its primary contribution is not an inference efficiency or serving method.

records.title: Learning to Self-Verify Makes Language Models Better Reasoners
records.reason: The reported gains come from model training and task accuracy. No inference-time reduction in compute, memory, latency, or serving resource use is established.

records.title: Beyond Max Tokens: Stealthy Resource Amplification via Tool Calling Chains in LLM Agents
records.reason: The paper demonstrates multi-turn tool-call chains as an economic denial-of-service/resource-amplification attack and evaluates resource impact and defenses. It is relevant to agentic serving risk, but not a serving optimization method.

records.title: DeepPersona: A Generative Engine for Scaling Deep Synthetic Personas
records.reason: The contribution concerns scaling persona generation and synthetic data quality. The memory and infrastructure lineage labels do not match a tested inference-system method.
